summary: Rabbi Tawil explores the connection between the laws of Hanukkah candles and the story of Yosef being thrown into a pit, both of which involve the challenge of seeing what is not immediately apparent. He explains that just as we must look for the hidden hand of Hashem in our daily lives, we should also strive to look past our initial judgments of others to uncover their inner potential. The class emphasizes the importance of being attentive and mindful to the miracles and opportunities for growth that Hashem places before us.
questions: Why are we not allowed to light Hanukkah candles higher than 20 amot?
How does the story of Yosef in the pit relate to the laws of Hanukkah?
Why do we focus on the miracle of the candles rather than the military victory?
Why are we forbidden from using the light of the Hanukkah candles for our own needs?
How can we avoid judging others too quickly?
